Criterion.Name: Criterion 1
Criterion.Summary: Concept map has comprehensive breakdown of project concepts and associated keywords and clearly shows how the different aspects connect with each other,

Criterion.Name: Criterion 2
Criterion.Summary: Search statement(s) unmistakeably logical and highly effective. Logical arrangement of Boolean search operators. Effective use of truncation and wildcards. Use of field restriction; e.g. limit to keywords, controlled vocabulary, topic classification.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 3
Criterion.Summary: Search conducted in an obviously useful database. Comprehensive justification for choosing that search database provided. Highly cogent evaluation of the usefulness and relevance of the chosen database.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 4
Criterion.Summary: All three required categories of information sources are provided. Key, reputable, highly relevant information source titles clearly germane to research topic/research question identified.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 5
Criterion.Summary: Each paper cogently and effectively summarised to distil the essence. Lucid, insightful discussion provided showing clear relevance of findings to the research question.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 6
Criterion.Summary: Unambiguous (non-QUT) expert identified Expert has numerous well-cited and/or recent academic publications on the topic Expert's website / ORCiD ID linked to x 3 instances.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 7
Criterion.Summary: Literature trends, current research developments and controversies are comprehensively identified. A research gap, an unexplored area, an unanswered question or a conflicting finding in existing knowledge is identified.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 8
Criterion.Summary: Recently published literature findings have most clearly informed and influenced the student's project research design. E.g., the student is now pursuing knowledge to close a reported research gap.

Criterion.Name: Criterion 9
Criterion.Summary: Completely consistent reference style used. Fulsome bibliographic information is laid out precisely following the prescribed style conventions. and References are unambiguously highly relevant to the project topic.
